Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anjali - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Manoj - 45 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Aditya: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya searches for his lost ball.]

Anjali: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya whispers something to Mother.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya gets frightened and steps back.]

Aditya: "I'm ready!"

[Aditya carries his school bag on his back.]

Anjali (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Aditya: "Mom, are you okay?"

[The sun is blazing and Aditya is sweating.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Anjali: "I really enjoyed today."
